# Face recognition model

`face_recognition_sface_2021dec.onnx`: SFace, from the [OpenCV model zoo](https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_recognition_sface),
Apache 2.0 licence. Used by `helpers/passport/faceEmbedHelper.js` for the passport face match.
Not in git (38 MB): `npm run models:download` fetches it and checks its SHA-256.
